The eth32config program is a tool that allows you to configure the network 
parameters of the ETH32 device.  The tool is available for both Linux and 
Windows platforms.

Before running the program, make sure that the ETH32 device is plugged into 
the network on the same segment as your PC.  In other words, it must not 
be separated by a router.  This is because the tool uses UDP broadcast packets 
to detect and configure the device and broadcast packets are not 
forwarded by routers.
